note: Kortrijk: Burgundian wall (1354-1454, 5 gates, 26 towers) including Overleie north of the Leie, bastioned between 1577 and 1648 (completed by the French in 1646-48, who also built a pentagonal citadel on the east flank of Overbeke, 1647-84; the town was Spanish again from 1648). Traced from the Ferraris map (1777) along the main rampart; the citadel is a landmark point only (not on Ferraris).
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Kortrijk' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140006)
